name: Motherly
source:
Quione starts questioning her role as a mother after disturbing events force her to choose between her two sons.

[From [url=https://mustacheskulls.itch.io/motherly]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在令人不安的事件迫使她在两个儿子之间做出选择后，奎奥内开始质疑自己作为母亲的角色。

[来自[url=https://mustacheskulls.itch.io/motherly]itch.io[/url]]
